Limit[n=15]
  Sort[keys=l.quantity DESC]
    Project[l.id AS lineitem_id, o.id AS order_id, p.name AS part_name, p.retail_price AS retail_price, l.quantity AS quantity, l.extended_price AS extended_price]
      Filter[o.order_status = 'F' AND p.size > 10]
        Join[kind=inner, cond=l.part_id = p.id]
          Join[kind=inner, cond=l.order_id = o.id]
            Scan[lineitem]
            Scan[orders]
          Scan[part]
